criteria.label: Problem framing
criteria.description: Defines the metric, time windows, and the decision leadership needs.
criteria.weak: Jumps straight into numbers without restating what is being measured or why.
criteria.strong: States the metric, compares like-for-like windows, and frames the decision (real vs. artifact, which team acts).

criteria.label: Data quality
criteria.description: Finds and handles the duplicate mobile events before trusting the trend.
criteria.weak: Takes the sessions table at face value.
criteria.strong: Identifies re-sent mobile events tied to app 5.2.0, deduplicates with a sensible rule, and re-measures the decline.

criteria.label: Segmentation
criteria.description: Splits the trend by acquisition cohort, device, and experiment arm.
criteria.strong: Shows existing users are roughly flat while campaign users are low-engagement, and isolates the experiment arm effect.

criteria.label: Causal reasoning
criteria.description: Separates three simultaneous changes instead of blaming one.
criteria.weak: Attributes the whole decline to one cause because it lines up in time.
criteria.strong: Distinguishes measurement artifact, mix shift, and treatment effect, with rough sizes and stated uncertainty.

criteria.label: Recommendation
criteria.strong: Fix/annotate the metric (data eng), cohort-based reporting (analytics), review autoplay_next_v2 before rollout (product).

criteria.label: Communication
criteria.description: Decision-ready summary with evidence and caveats.
criteria.weak: Long dump of queries with no bottom line.
criteria.strong: Short summary up front, evidence table, explicit caveats, clear action order.
